lost_error: the worker lost the job (restart or crash) — it went back to the queue
lost_final: the worker failed to finish the job twice — check that it and ComfyUI are alive
draw_unset: not set in Admin space · Drawing: {names}
draw_none: the drawing service returned no images
news_silent: the journalist never answered — order again
news_failed: the dispatches did not get written — order again
draw_no_answer: the drawing service did not answer: {exc}
draw_no_image: the drawing service returned no image
draw_timeout: the drawing service didn't finish in {min} min — the generation queue is stuck
edit_unsupported: the drawing service cannot edit an area — needs the standard images/edits (gpt-image) or the worker
